note: Khazar-Arab Wars (note: against caliphal Damascus, not Iberian Umayyads — relationship reflects broader Umayyad pressure).

_quarry.structural_significance: The Khazar military barrier in the Caucasus prevented Arab expansion into the Pontic steppe and eastern Europe during the Umayyad period's most aggressive phase; this containment preserved the non-Islamic character of the northern steppe and Kievan Rus regions, with profound long-term consequences for the religious geography of eastern Europe and Russia.
